Name: flaskr.auth.login
notes: E: credentials; R: user; X: error message. Session cookie is not persistent storage so no Write.

Name: flaskr.auth.logout
notes: Only clears the session cookie. Below the COSMIC minimum of 2 CFP; may not be a functional process at all. NEEDS DECISION.

Name: flaskr.auth.register
notes: E: username+password; W: user; X: error message. Duplicate check is done by the DB constraint so no separate Read.

Name: flaskr.blog.create
notes: E: title+body; W: post; X: error message.

Name: flaskr.blog.delete
notes: E: id; R: post + user (author check via get_post); W: post; X: 403/404 error message.

Name: flaskr.blog.index
notes: E: request; R: post + user (JOIN reads two objects of interest); X: post list. Counting the JOIN as 1 Read gives 3.

Name: flaskr.blog.update
notes: E: id+title+body; R: post + user (via get_post); W: post; X: current post shown in form + error message. GET and POST could be split into two processes.

Name: flaskr.db.init_db_command
notes: E: command; W: user table + post table (recreated); X: confirmation message.
